_note: 24 synthetic Sentinel-style EMA exchanges (Gemma prompt + user reply), hand-labeled safe/self_harm/harm_to_others. Deliberately includes tricky cases (metaphor, past-tense/resolved trauma, ambiguity) because a classifier that only sees easy cases tells you nothing about false-positive risk. This is a COMPLEMENT to swordhealth/MindGuard-testset on Hugging Face (1,134 clinician-annotated turns) -- that's the real benchmark; this small set exists specifically to test Sentinel's own EMA phrasing style, which the general testset wasn't built around. UPDATED: each case now includes a 'conversation' field with a shared 2-turn lead-in before the labeled exchange, because MindGuard's own model card states it is 'not meant to be used with single messages or with short context (1-2 turns)' -- the original prompt/reply-only format under-tested it outside its designed operating range.
